test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ministries launched the PM Daksh scheme?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The PM Daksh (Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi) scheme was launched by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** in 2021.

• The scheme aims to enhance the skill development among the target groups such as Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Economically Backward Classes, and sanitation workers, including waste pickers.

• It focuses on providing skill training to marginalized sections of the society, making them self-reliant and financially stable.

• Under the scheme, eligible candidates are provided with short-term and long-term skill training based on the National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF)**

• The NSQF is a competency-based framework that organizes all qualifications according to a series of levels of knowledge, skills, and aptitude.

• It aims to standardize the training and qualifications across various sectors to ensure quality and relevance in the skill development process.

• The NSQF levels range from 1 to 10, representing different levels of learning outcomes that a learner must possess.

• This framework is crucial for aligning the skill development initiatives with the needs of the industry, thereby enhancing employability.

• **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment**

• The Ministry is responsible for the welfare, social justice, and empowerment of disadvantaged and marginalized sections of society.

• It formulates policies, plans, and programs for promoting the welfare of Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Senior Citizens, and other vulnerable groups.

• The Ministry also implements various central sector and centrally sponsored schemes for the upliftment and empowerment of these groups.

• Some of the key initiatives include scholarships, skill development programs, and schemes for social security.
